# The probe capsule. Never inside a repository under study: `probes.py` copies this tree into

[package]
name = "datafusion-tracing-probes"
version = "0.0.0"
edition = "2024"
publish = false

[dependencies]
async-trait = "=0.1.92"
datafusion = { version = "55.0.0", default-features = false, features = ["parquet", "sql"] }
datafusion-tracing = "55.0.0"
instrumented-object-store = "55.0.0"
object_store = { version = "0.13.2", features = ["fs"] }
tokio = { version = "1.48", features = ["rt-multi-thread", "macros"] }
tracing = "0.1"
tracing-subscriber = { version = "0.3", features = ["registry", "json", "env-filter"] }
serde_json = "1"
futures = "0.3"

[[bin]]
name = "probe"
path = "src/main.rs"
